subject: Missions 6 and 8 credit their drone act against mission 1's sortie environment
description:
2026-08-10. The act layer gives all 14 z1 levels an act. Three are DRONE acts: m6 (ch-rf-topology, three named channels on one Ka front end), m8 (cable-map, physical cable count at the rack), m12 (ir-survey).

m12 IS mission 1's sortie, word for word: its corroborator reads 'Your own infrared survey of the three panels'. That one is correct and needs nothing.

m6 and m8 are NOT. They currently credit against cloud-cold-horizon.html because a dead end is worse than a stand-in, and the operator's requirement was playable and COMPLETABLE levels. But flying an infrared survey of HELIOS-7 does not establish an antenna topology or a cable count, and the box's whole thesis is that a reading carries only what its provenance supports. Shipping the stand-in quietly is the exact failure the box teaches against, so it is written into the code comment as well as here.

FIX: build two flight environments using lib/rsv-flight.js (extracted 1d878afe1 for precisely this):
  m6  antenna farm walk-down. Trace three feeds converging on one Ka front end; the omni beacon runs to a separate chain on the survival bus.
  m8  rack / cable count. Count what is physically plugged, against a map that claims otherwise.

Each is a config plus mission geometry, not a copy of the 2271-line sortie. Blocked by nothing.
[2026-08-11 00:42] Verified live 2026-08-10 20:45. Built in 0af916c4f after Chris BLOCKED the stand-in, deployed, and Chris PASSED. lagrange-inspect.html serves 200 with both environments: 6:ch-rf-topology renders ANTENNA FARM WALK-DOWN, 8:cable-map renders RACK CABLE COUNT, 4 inspection targets each, canvas and HUD up, 0 page errors against production. Findings are DERIVED from what was inspected, not asserted. Structural guards: cloud-cold-horizon.html credits exactly one act by allowlist (ACT_SATISFIED_HERE = 12:ir-survey), and lagrange-inspect.html refuses an act it has no environment for rather than flying a stand-in. Covered by acts-test.js (80/80) including 'routes to its OWN environment, not the thermal sortie' and 'finding matches the corroborator it earns'. The ticket was left pending only because I closed it in the SITREP and never marked the board.
